title: DDPM 擴散生成網路
summary: 以前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣解析DDPM 擴散生成網路：六個原理與架構單元、十二項可保存的分析及驗證作業，附假想量化例、來源及衍生工程比較。
summaryEn: Explore DDPM diffusion-generation network through forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling: six principle/architecture units and twelve saved analysis/validation tasks, with an assumed numerical example, primary sources and related engineering comparisons.
scope: 原創張量、運算成本及失效分析。架構圖是功能教學示意，非晶片floorplan或專有電路；數字為假想，需依精度、shape、資料分佈與系統邊界重算。
scopeEn: Original tensor, compute-cost and failure analysis. Functional diagrams are not chip floorplans/proprietary circuits; assumed values need recalculation for precision, shape, data and boundaries.

stages.title: 系統邊界與基本原理
stages.description: 在DDPM 擴散生成網路案例中比較clean sample與noise與time-conditioned U-Net，各完成分析及驗證。
stages.descriptionEn: Analyze and validate clean samples/noise and time-conditioned u-net within the DDPM diffusion-generation network case.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：架構分析
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: architecture analysis
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識clean sample與noise。DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 建立前向加噪與邊際的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify clean samples/noise in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of forward noising and marginals, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
steps.check: 提交clean sample與noise的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for clean samples/noise.

knowledge.title: 獨立驗證與失效邊界
knowledge.text: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 應逐項保留基準與不確定度；每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。 是本單元要排除的誤解。
knowledge.textEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Retain each reference and uncertainty; reject the misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.

knowledge.title: 原創假想量化練習
knowledge.text: 假設q(x_t|x_0)中ᾱ_t=0.81，x_0=2、ε=−1，x_t=√0.81×2+√0.19×(−1)=1.364110。這是單一前向加噪例；noise prediction loss與反向生成品質不同，非特定模型權重結果。
knowledge.textEn: Assume alpha_bar=0.81, x0=2 and epsilon=−1: xt=sqrt(0.81)*2−sqrt(0.19)=1.364110. This is one forward-noising example; noise loss differs from reverse-generation quality and is not an output from model weights.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的「前向加噪與邊際：架構分析」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出輸入資料、處理狀態、傳輸與輸出的邊界，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「算力中心：核心不是答案」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與輸入版本、時間追蹤、資源計數與可重播的小型測試的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Forward noising and marginals: architecture analysis” in “DDPM diffusion-generation network”. Draw the input, processing state, transport and output boundaries; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Compute Center: Cores Are Not the Answer” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for input version, time traces, resource counters and a replayable small test, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 就clean sample與noise的「前向加噪與邊際」，哪個推論或驗證成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for forward noising and marginals in clean samples/noise?
options: DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。
每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
optionsEn: DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale.
Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
Equal case averages rule out spatial, temporal and model errors.
quiz.explanation: DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。
quiz.explanationEn: DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.

steps.title: 前向加噪與邊際：證據驗證
steps.titleEn: Forward noising and marginals: evidence validation
steps.objective: 針對clean sample與noise提出可反駁的前向加噪與邊際模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable forward noising and marginals model and evidence record for clean samples/noise.
steps.instruction: 沿用前一步「前向加噪與邊際」模型，檢查clean sample與noise的兩個假想案例。手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。 先訂可接受誤差，再比較預測與獨立計算；區分DDPM前向邊際可寫x_t=√ᾱ_t x_0+√(1−ᾱ_t)ε；噪聲尺度隨時間條件而變。與另一個可能造成相同輸出的機制。保存輸入、殘差、不確定度及採信／保留理由。缺少公開資料就標示尚未驗證，不補造產品數字。
steps.instructionEn: Use the previous forward noising and marginals model to inspect two hypothetical cases involving clean samples/noise. Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance. Set acceptable error before comparing predictions with an independent calculation. Distinguish "DDPM marginals use xt=sqrt(alpha_bar)x0+sqrt(1-alpha_bar)epsilon, with timestep-dependent noise scale." from an alternative cause with similar output. Save inputs, residuals, uncertainty and accept/hold reasoning. Mark absent public evidence as unverified rather than inventing product values.
steps.observation: 手算指定ᾱ與ε的一維例，再核對均值方差。
steps.observationEn: Hand-calculate a specified one-dimensional case and check mean/variance.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：每個時間步都必然加入完全相同總噪聲。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Every timestep necessarily has the same total noise.
steps.check: 提交clean sample與noise的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for clean samples/noise.

steps.title: 時間條件噪聲預測：架構分析
steps.objective: 針對time-conditioned U-Net提出可反駁的時間條件噪聲預測模型與驗證紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: Produce a falsifiable time-conditioned noise prediction model and evidence record for time-conditioned u-net.
steps.instruction: 在「DDPM 擴散生成網路」的師傅示意與公開來源中，先辨識time-conditioned U-Net。去噪網路需知道噪聲等級；噪聲預測loss与生成分布品質不是同一指標。 建立時間條件噪聲預測的輸入、狀態、輸出及邊界圖；本課重點是前向加噪、時間條件去噪與反向採樣。用本課假想算例建立基準，再只改一個相關假設，預測哪個輸出先變。比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。 記錄單位、未公開參數及模型失效條件。
steps.instructionEn: Identify time-conditioned u-net in the mentor diagram and primary sources for DDPM diffusion-generation network. Denoisers need noise-level conditions; noise-prediction loss differs from generated-distribution quality. Draw the inputs, states, outputs and boundaries of time-conditioned noise prediction, focusing on forward noising, time-conditioned denoising and reverse sampling. Establish a baseline with the hypothetical worked example, change one relevant assumption and predict the first affected output. Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions. Record units, undisclosed parameters and model breakdown conditions.
steps.observation: 比較相同帶噪輸入在兩種時間條件的預測及loss。
steps.observationEn: Compare predictions/loss for one noisy input under two time conditions.
steps.failure: 常見誤判：去掉時間條件不會影響任何去噪任務。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: Removing time conditioning affects no denoising task.
steps.check: 提交time-conditioned U-Net的系統邊界圖、兩案例計算、單位／不確定度表及一項能區分競爭機制的證據。
steps.checkEn: Submit a boundary diagram, two-case calculation, units/uncertainty table and discriminating evidence for time-conditioned u-net.

quiz.questionEn: Which inference or check is justified for time-conditioned noise prediction in time-conditioned u-net?
options: 去掉時間條件不會影響任何去噪任務。
兩個案例的平均相同，就足以排除空間、時間及模型誤差。
